description: This file defines internal interfaces for persistent stream pulling agents and managers within the Orleans streaming framework, specifying asynchronous initialization, control, and command execution methods.

classes.name: IPersistentStreamPullingAgent
classes.description: Interface for a persistent stream pulling agent, extending system target and stream producer extension, with methods for initialization and shutdown.

classes.name: IPersistentStreamPullingManager
classes.description: Interface for managing persistent stream pulling agents, with methods for initialization, stopping, starting/stopping agents, and executing commands.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes a command on the stream provider with an argument, returning a task with a result.
